title: 第三章 安身之处第四章 追忆一第五章 追忆二
lines: 门外站着五个男人，面色略显愁苦，显然饱经苦难。不过当他们看到了屋内简陋的设施，也都皱了皱眉。
“好不容易见到了人家，还是个穷鬼。大姐，有没有吃的，赶紧拿出来。”
“没，没有。”
“他娘的，我就不信了。兄弟们，搜。”话音刚落，几个大汉就行动起来。屋子并不大，夜天云虽躲在柴堆之中，仍被轻易发现。
“老大，这有个小鬼。”
“别伤害他，他是我的孩子。”此时大娘赶紧说道。
“你的孩子，嘿嘿，竟然还拿着把刀，不过这把刀应该能卖几个钱吧。”为首的男子显然看出夜天云的刀不是凡品，也不等夜天云答话，就将手伸向夜天云。
夜天云身子一闪，避开了男子的手掌，自己父母唯一的遗物，怎么可能会交给别人？！虽然自己初临这个危险的世界不想惹麻烦，但既然对方已经触及到了自己的逆鳞，那么。。。
大娘正想劝解，却听为首的大汉道：娘的，几天了，连个鸟都劫不到，一个小鬼都敢与我作对。”右手向怀中一掏，拿出了把匕首。
“求你了，他还是个孩子。”此时大娘也替夜天云求情。
场面有些混乱，不过没有人注意，此时夜天云的眼神泛起冷冽的光芒，但脸上却泛起了若有若无的微笑。
“臭娘们，还敢啰嗦，我先送你上路。”连续几天没有收获，在这个生命如草芥的乱世，他们时刻处于生死危机中，精神早就处于崩溃的边缘。
“噗“的一声响，那是利刃入肉的声音。夜天云心中微叹，对眼前已经失去生机的农妇产生一丝遗憾，毕竟自己受了人家一饭之恩。
见血的男子已经疯狂，一不做二不休，想要直接将夜天云杀死，挥舞着匕首向夜天云刺去。
寒光一闪，男子握着匕首的手齐腕而断，落在地上发出沉闷的声响。夜天云单手持刀看着一众强盗，脸上挂着冰冷的，仿佛置人于寒冬腊月的笑容。
事情发生的太过于突然，众人都没有时间反应。看着沾满灰尘的地面上已被染上了殷红，众人一动不动，气氛诡异无比。
“啊！！！！”凄厉的惨叫声响起，将所有人的思绪拉了回来，夜天云看着眼前的男子捂着手腕惨叫着，脸色因为剧痛和恐惧而变得惨白无比，没有丝毫的怜悯，挽了个刀花，将对方的大腿直接贯穿，男子无力支撑身体，趴跪在地上嚎叫。
见到老大被对方砍成重伤，剩余四人的眼中充满了怒火。他们还没有意识到实力的差距，单纯的认为对方只是个七八岁的小鬼。
“臭小鬼！！！！”其中一个人按捺不住怒火，冲了上去，挥舞着拳头向夜天云脸上打去。
没有预料中对方被打飞出去的场景，大汉的拳头打在了空气上，正当惊疑之际，身后传来一声惨叫。
夜天云不知何时出现在了自己的身后，挥刀斩向另一名同伴，速度之快超乎寻常，被攻击的男子胸腹处迸发了一丝血雾，便倒地不起。
剩余的强盗眼中充满了恐惧和惊疑，意识到眼前看似手无缚鸡之力的小孩儿拥有他们难以理解的实力，屋子中的惨叫声更是时刻在刺痛着他们的神经，终于崩溃，落荒而逃。
不过刚刚转过身去，却见一个矮小的身影站在了门前，不是夜天云又是何人。
“鬼魅？！”三人此时都是一般心思，惊惧不已。
没有理会对方绝望的神色，夜天云轻轻转动着手腕，舞了一个刀花，欺身向前，动作迅捷无比，眨眼便来到了三人面前，墨色的太刀泛出刺骨的寒光。
夜晚，乌云将月亮遮挡了起来，不想让她看到正在发生的杀戮。
断掌的男子仍旧跪趴在地上，长时间的哀嚎早已让他的嗓子嘶哑，声音也变得微弱，冷汗已经浸透了衣衫。
男子的眼神已经变得空洞，自己同行的四人已经长眠于此，地面早已经被鲜血浸得殷红。看着站在前方的夜天云，瘦小的身躯此刻在眼中如同魔鬼一般。
看着跪趴在地上已经哀嚎到失声的男子，眼神已经变得无神的男子，夜天云没有丝毫的犹豫，将刀高高举起，而后，重重的落下。
天空乌云密布，蒙蒙的细雨滴落在地上发出滴滴声响，路边的一块岩石下，夜天云正双膝盘地而坐，闭着双目。
经过了一番杀戮，自己心中的戾气和烦恼也被驱散了大半，夜天云对于今后的路也不得不做出一些考虑。虽然自己对火影的剧情略知一二，但现在是战争时期，实力，才是活下去的保障！
不过剧情虽起不了决定性的作用，但不可否认夜天云的思路会因此而清晰许多。
content_en:
There were five men standing outside the door. Their faces looked slightly sad, and they had obviously suffered a lot. But when they saw the simple facilities in the house, they all frowned.
"It's not easy to see this person, but he is still a poor man. Sister, if you have anything to eat, please bring it out quickly."
"No, no."
"Damn it, I don't believe it anymore. Brothers, search." As soon as he finished speaking, several big men took action. The house was not big, and even though Ye Tianyun was hiding among the firewood, he was still easily discovered.
"Boss, there is a kid here."
"Don't hurt him, he is my child." The aunt said quickly at this time.
"Your child, hehe, is actually holding a knife, but this knife should be sold for a few dollars." The leading man obviously saw that Ye Tianyun's knife was not an ordinary thing, and stretched out his hand to Ye Tianyun without waiting for Ye Tianyun to answer.
Ye Tianyun dodged and avoided the man's hand. How could his parents' only relic be handed over to others? ! Although I didn't want to cause trouble when I first came to this dangerous world, but now that the other party has touched my reverse scale, then. . .
The aunt was about to persuade her, but she heard the big man at the head say: Damn, it's been a few days, and I can't even rob a bird, and even a kid dares to go against me. " He reached into his pocket with his right hand and took out a dagger.
“Please, he’s still a kid. "At this time, the aunt also interceded for Ye Tianyun.
The scene was a bit chaotic, but no one paid attention. At this time, Ye Tianyun's eyes glowed coldly, but a faint smile appeared on his face.
"You bitch, if you still dare to be nagging, I'll send you on your way first. "Without harvesting for several consecutive days, in this troubled world where life is like straw, they are always in crisis of life and death, and their spirits are already on the verge of collapse.
There was a "pop" sound, which was the sound of a sharp knife entering flesh. Ye Tianyun sighed in his heart, feeling a little regretful for the lifeless peasant woman in front of him. After all, he had received a favor from someone else.
The man who saw the blood went crazy and kept doing anything. He wanted to kill Ye Tianyun directly, and stabbed Ye Tianyun with a dagger.
There was a flash of cold light, and the man's hand holding the dagger was broken at the wrist, and it fell to the ground with a dull sound. Ye Tianyun held a knife in one hand and looked at the group of robbers, with a cold smile on his face, as if he was in the cold winter.
Things happened so suddenly that no one had time to react. Seeing that the dusty ground was stained with bright red, everyone remained motionless, and the atmosphere was extremely strange.
"Ah! ! ! ! "A shrill scream rang out, pulling everyone back from their thoughts. Ye Tianyun watched the man in front of him cover his wrists and scream, his face turned extremely pale due to the severe pain and fear. Without any mercy, he pulled a knife and penetrated the other person's thigh directly. The man was unable to support his body, and he knelt on the ground and howled.
Seeing that the boss was seriously injured by the other party, the eyes of the remaining four were filled with anger. They haven't realized the difference in strength yet, and simply think that the other person is just a kid of seven or eight years old.
“Smelly brat! ! ! ! "One of them couldn't hold back his anger, rushed forward, and hit Ye Tianyun in the face with his fist.
Unexpectedly, the opponent was knocked away. The big man's fist hit the air. Just when he was in shock, a scream came from behind.
Ye Tianyun didn't know when he appeared behind him, slashing at another companion with his knife. The speed was extraordinary. A trace of blood mist burst out from the chest and abdomen of the man who was attacked, and he fell to the ground.
The eyes of the remaining robbers were full of fear and suspicion, realizing that the seemingly powerless child in front of them had strength that they could not understand. The screams in the room were tingling their nerves all the time, and they finally collapsed and ran away.
But just when he turned around, he saw a short figure standing in front of the door. Who could it be if it wasn't Ye Tianyun.
“Ghost? ! "The three of them were all thinking normally at this time, and were terrified.
Ignoring the other party's despairing look, Ye Tianyun gently turned his wrist, made a sword dance, leaned forward, and with extremely quick movements, he was in front of the three of them in the blink of an eye, the dark sword glowing with a biting cold light.
At night, dark clouds obscured the moon, not wanting her to see the killings taking place.
The man with the severed arm was still kneeling on the ground. The long period of wailing had already made his throat hoarse and his voice became weak. Cold sweat had soaked his clothes.
The man's eyes had become empty. The four people he was traveling with had already rested here, and the ground was already soaked in blood. Looking at Ye Tianyun standing in front, his thin body looked like a devil in his eyes.
Looking at the man who was kneeling on the ground, wailing until he lost his voice, and whose eyes had become lifeless, Ye Tianyun did not hesitate at all, raised the knife high, and then dropped it heavily.
The sky was covered with dark clouds, and the drizzle fell on the ground with a sound. Under a rock on the roadside, Ye Tianyun was sitting with his knees crossed, his eyes closed.
After a lot of killing, most of the anger and troubles in his heart were dispelled, and Ye Tianyun had to make some considerations about the future. Although I know a little about Naruto's plot, this is a time of war, and strength is the guarantee of survival!
However, although the plot cannot play a decisive role, it is undeniable that Ye Tianyun's thinking will be much clearer as a result.
